scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api "npm run dev -w @release-check/web" "npm run dev -w @release-check/api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck -w @release-check/api && npm run typecheck -w @release-check/web
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @release-check/api && npm run build -w @release-check/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api "npm run start -w @release-check/web" "npm run start -w @release-check/api"
